company_profile: Vestas designs, manufactures, installs and services wind turbines worldwide, and its AI/ML Chapter builds ML, GenAI and agentic solutions across its value chain.
title: Specialist, Machine Learning Engineer
summary: Machine Learning Engineer with 8+ years designing, building and deploying production ML, GenAI and agentic systems across Healthcare, Telecom and AIOps, with an MSc in Machine Learning and AI. Builds LangGraph multi-agent and RAG applications with evaluation, tracing and human-in-the-loop review, alongside classical ML for prediction and anomaly detection. Ships with FastAPI, Docker, Kubernetes, MLflow and Terraform on Azure and GCP, working closely with business stakeholders. Currently building ThinkTree.AI, a non-profit AI learning platform used by NGO teachers to support students with ADHD.

project.name: Agentic Maintenance Triage Assistant
bullets: Built a LangGraph agent that plans and runs maintenance triage for industrial assets, reasoning over sensor alarms, service logs and manuals with RAG and tool calls.
Served the agent as a containerised FastAPI service on Kubernetes with human-in-the-loop approval, tracing and drift monitoring, deployed on Azure through CI/CD with Terraform.

paragraphs: I am applying for the Specialist, Machine Learning Engineer role in the AI/ML Chapter. I design and ship ML, GenAI and agentic systems into production, most recently multi-agent LLM applications in healthcare after years of predictive ML in telecom. The thread through all of it is turning a promising use case into a service people depend on.

Vestas applies AI to renewable energy, where better operations have a direct effect on the climate, and building agentic workflows for that is work I would find meaningful. My fiancée lives in Berlin, and we plan to move to Copenhagen together and settle there long term. I have also worked closely with teams in India, which fits your setup.

I would bring experience across the full lifecycle. I built a LangGraph multi-agent chatbot that cut manual analysis by 98%, with evaluation and tracing pipelines that reduced human review by 43%. Earlier I put a LightGBM prediction system into production with FastAPI and MLflow, and I use Docker, Kubernetes and Terraform day to day.

Alongside work I am building ThinkTree.AI, a non-profit AI learning platform used by NGO teachers to support students with ADHD. It keeps me grounded in building for real users, carefully. I would be glad to talk about how I could contribute to the team.
